critique: The render has the essential Fireflies look: a black field with scattered, softly blooming green-yellow points and a few larger hero glows. Particle distribution is broad and the frame-to-frame change suggests gentle drifting rather than rigidly static dots. However, the color behavior is visibly inconsistent: frame 1 has the warmer yellow-green firefly variation associated with the preset, while frame 4 has shifted almost entirely to highly saturated neon green. This reads as a global timed color sweep rather than natural, individually varied fireflies, and the later frame loses the warm luminous balance of the thumbnail-like look.

suggestions.why: Remove the synchronized yellow-to-neon-green time sweep so the fireflies retain a stable natural yellow-green base color throughout the animation.
Introduce per-particle color variation so the field contains a persistent mix of warmer yellow and greener fireflies instead of becoming uniformly saturated green.
